summary: Add GET /api/alerts/trends?days=N returning one bucket per UTC calendar day (oldest first) for the last N days, each with a total count and per-severity counts, including zero-count days and severities.

acceptance_criteria.text: GET /api/alerts/trends with no days parameter defaults to 7 days.
days accepts a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 90; the response contains exactly N buckets, one per UTC calendar day for the last N days, ordered oldest first.
Each daily bucket exposes a total alert-creation count and a count per severity (Low, Medium, High, Critical), emitting zero for days and severities with no alerts.
The per-severity shape and ordering reuse the existing summary endpoint conventions (AlertSeverityCountsResponse: Low, Medium, High, Critical).
Invalid days (out of the 1-90 range or non-numeric) returns 400 with ValidationProblemDetails, consistent with existing query validation.

scope_anchors: AlertManagementService._timeProvider for UTC now / day-window boundary
adjacent_dependencies: AlertService.DTO/Requests/AlertTrendsQueryRequest.cs (new; days query param with Range(1,90) default 7, matching AlertQueryRequest validation style)
AlertService.DTO/Responses/AlertDailyTrendResponse.cs (new; one UTC day: Date, TotalCount, SeverityCounts)
AlertService.DTO/Responses/AlertSeverityCountsResponse.cs (reuse for per-severity counts; no change expected)
constraints: Additive only: do not change existing GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE behavior; add a new read-only trends endpoint and its support methods.
Buckets are keyed by UTC calendar day of CreatedDate; return exactly N contiguous days ending at today (UTC), oldest first, with zero-count days materialized.
Use the injected TimeProvider for the UTC 'now' / day-window boundary; do not call DateTime.UtcNow directly (consistent with CreateAsync).
Reuse AlertSeverityCountsResponse (Low, Medium, High, Critical) for per-severity counts to preserve summary-endpoint ordering; do not introduce a divergent severity shape.
Validate days via a [FromQuery] request DTO with [Range(1,90)] and default 7 so [ApiController] emits ValidationProblemDetails automatically, matching AlertQueryRequest.
Keep EF aggregation efficient: group in the repository (group by date + severity) and materialize zero-fill in the service; do not load all alert rows into memory.
coverage_goals: Behavior coverage of all five acceptance criteria: default days=7, min/max boundaries (1 and 90), N contiguous oldest-first UTC buckets with zero-count day and severity fill, per-severity shape matching the summary endpoint, and 400 ValidationProblemDetails for out-of-range and non-numeric days.
